subject: Film & Cinema
title: Sergei Eisenstein: Editing as Art
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Sergei Eisenstein: Editing as Art.

hook.text: Eisenstein didn't just cut film. He turned the cut itself into cinema's most expressive tool.

buildup.text: His theory of montage argued that meaning emerges from the collision of two images.

discovery.text: The Odessa Steps sequence in Battleship Potemkin remains one of cinema's most studied scenes.

twist.text: Stalin eventually censored Eisenstein, fearing his art was too independent.

climax.text: His theories are taught in every film school on Earth, nearly a century later.

punchline.text: He made the invisible cut the most visible art.

quiz.question: What is Eisenstein's montage theory?
options: Meaning emerges from the collision of juxtaposed images
